name: Amberley Castle
niche_feature: Genuine walled medieval castle; its 19 bedrooms are in different parts of the estate: Manor House, Tower House Mews, and Gatehouse Suites in the 17th-century Bishopric Dairy just beyond the walls.
evidence_quote: rooms occupy different parts of the estate, from the Manor House and Tower House Mews to the Bishopric Dairy beyond the walls.
reason: Official site confirms a 900-year-old walled castle with guest rooms in castle buildings; some suites sit outside the walls in a dairy.
page_issues: Says curtain walls stand at original height; official history says 20-30 ft was lost after 1643 Civil War slighting
Says rooms are set inside the original towers and gatehouse; official site lists Manor House, Tower House Mews and Bishopric Dairy, no tower/gatehouse rooms
Queen's Room in gatehouse, daily portcullis raising, 'one of the most perfectly preserved' are not supported by the official pages

name: Ashford Castle
niche_feature: Historic castle with origins in the 13th century, run as a hotel; official site lists 83 rooms, suites and the separate lakeside Boathouse. It does not map which rooms are in the castle fabric. The Lodge is a separate hotel.
evidence_quote: With origins dating back to the 13th century, magnificent Ashford Castle has witnessed a rich and storied history
reason: Official site confirms a genuine medieval-origin castle hotel; Boathouse is a separate unit and the room-by-building split is not stated.
page_issues: 'Built in 1228' not stated by official site (says origins in the 13th century)
'83 individually designed rooms': official figure is 83 rooms, suites and the Boathouse
'Ireland's best falconry school' / 'rated among the best in the world' and 'Michelin recognition' are unsupported superlatives on the official pages I checked

name: Augill Castle
niche_feature: 19th-century castle; castle rooms (most with four-posters) are in the castle itself, but the hotel also lets Garden Suites, Family Estate Houses and a Stable House outside the main building.
evidence_quote: Augill Castle is a 19th century castle nestled between the Yorkshire Dales and Cumbria’s Lake District.
reason: Real castellated 19th-century castle where guests sleep; rooms are split between castle and separate garden/estate/stable units.
page_issues: Page does not mention the Garden Suites, Family Estate Houses and Stable House listed on the official stay page
'Gothic Revival' and 'originally a private residence' not stated on the official pages I read (castle is 19th century)

name: Ballygally Castle Hotel
niche_feature: 17th-century castle hotel; Tower Bedrooms are in the original castle building, while the hotel has 54 bedrooms in total. Source does not give the count of castle rooms.
evidence_quote: These individually appointed bedrooms are located in the 17th Century Castle building and ooze with character and charm.
reason: Official site confirms a 17th-century castle with Tower Bedrooms inside it; most of the 54 rooms are not specified as castle rooms.
page_issues: Official homepage was behind a Cloudflare block for curl; text obtained via fetch tool, not directly verified line by line
Page says most rooms are in later extensions; official text I obtained does not state the split

name: Banwell Castle
niche_feature: Grade II* listed Gothic Revival castle (mansion complete by 1847, Victorian rather than medieval); bed-and-breakfast rooms are in the main mansion house, which is still a family home.
evidence_quote: Banwell Castle remains very much the Parsons family home but guests are welcome to stay in this landmark building, which is listed grade 2 star.
reason: Castle-style Gothic Revival building where guests sleep; it is Victorian and the official site looks dated (c.2009), so current availability is unconfirmed.
page_issues: Official site is stale (copyright 2009, Flash notice); current B&B operation and rates could not be confirmed
Castle is a Victorian Gothic Revival mansion, not medieval; page does say Victorian
Rating 7.6 is unsourced

name: Barcaldine Castle
niche_feature: Early 17th-century L-plan tower house with 9-ft walls; all six guest rooms are inside the castle, taken as B&B or whole castle for exclusive use.
evidence_quote: all six unique guest rooms feature rich and luxurious fabrics to create an elegant, traditional look and a relaxing, romantic ambience.
reason: Official site confirms a 1601-1609 tower house where all six rooms are in the castle.
page_issues: Official homepage says built 1590-1609 while the history page says 1601-1609; page follows the history page

name: Barony Castle Hotel
niche_feature: Historic Scots-baronial house of 1536 on a peel-tower site (Jacobean facade c.1700-15, 19th-century wing, 1983 fire); the rest is 20th-century additions, and the source does not say which of 82 rooms are in the old house.
evidence_quote: In 1536 a Scots’ baronial style building was erected on the site of the old peel tower which retained the name of Darnhall.
reason: Genuine historic castle-house core confirmed, but the official site does not say how many of the 82 bedrooms lie in historic fabric versus modern additions.
page_issues: Page calls it a 16th-century castle; history page shows 1536 house rebuilt c.1700-15, extended in the 19th century and gutted by fire in 1983, with 'the remainder' 20th-century additions
'82 bedrooms' are not stated to be in the castle itself; page admits it is a larger hotel than most castle stays

name: Borgo Castello Panicaglia
niche_feature: Rooms in a castle dating from 1266 within the borgo of Panicaglia; the site lists about 17 named rooms and suites, plus the Michele holiday house, which adjoins the hotel rather than being in the castle.
evidence_quote: The Medieval village Panicaglia houses a unique castle from 1266.
reason: Official site confirms a 13th-century castle guesthouse; it does not map each room to the castle, and one unit is an adjoining house.
page_issues: Page says all rooms have private bathrooms and tea/coffee; not checked on room pages
Official room list also includes Michele holiday house (adjoining the hotel) and several rooms the page does not name

name: Castello della Pieve
niche_feature: Former medieval fortified castle, now a restored stone hamlet of seven houses, a surviving tower and a consecrated chapel; rooms are in the restored hamlet houses and the Torre delle Muse suite.
evidence_quote: Le sette case in pietra, l’antica torre e la chiesetta, ancora consacrata, dominano con il loro antico fascino le suggestive macchie boschive dell’Alpe della Luna.
reason: Official history says a fortified 12th-century castle that became a borgo; rooms are in its restored houses and tower. Castle is partly ruined into a hamlet.
page_issues: Dante's exile claim is the property's own tradition (page attributes it correctly)
Official homepage says 'eight romantic rooms' while room list shows about 10 units

name: Castello di Casamassella
niche_feature: Authentic medieval castle (fortified residence under Charles of Anjou); five suites and one double room on different floors of the castle itself, also offered for exclusive-use self-catering.
evidence_quote: Cinque suite esclusive e una camera matrimoniale arredate con cura ed eleganza vi accoglieranno nei diversi piani del Castello.
reason: Official site confirms a medieval castle where all six rooms are inside it.
page_issues: Site (copyright 2021) also markets self-catering exclusive-use castle rental; page presents only B&B-style rooms

name: Castello di Fagnano Albergo Diffuso & Spa
niche_feature: Official site is in maintenance mode with only a room list (Casa Carluccio, Casa Ercolino). Wikipedia describes a fortified medieval Castello hamlet in Fagnano Alto, but no citable source links the hotel's houses to the walled castle.
reason: Could not confirm guests sleep inside a castle or castle-built buildings; official site is under maintenance and stale.
page_issues: Official site is in maintenance mode, so room counts, spa and pool claims could not be checked against it
Page itself says the feel is 'a quiet hamlet rather than a fortress'; castle link to the hotel unsupported
Hamlet 'Castello' is a fortified medieval borgo per Wikipedia, but the page does not show the houses are within it

name: Castello di Gargonza
niche_feature: Fortified medieval village (13th-century tower, first recorded 1150); guests sleep in restored peasant houses inside the walls as rooms, suites and apartments, and in the medieval tower.
evidence_quote: Oggi abbiamo restaurato tutte le case dei contadini, che sono diventate splendide camere, suite e appartamenti, e la torre medievale.
reason: Official site confirms a fortified medieval castle-village where all accommodation is in restored houses and tower within the walls.
page_issues: Page's 'bar in the village shop' and restaurant-outside-walls details not re-verified
